facts.fact: The article defines Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) as how much a business has to spend, on average, to win one new customer.

facts.fact: The article defines Conversion Rate as the percentage of website visitors who take the desired action, such as making a purchase or signing up.
facts.quote: What percentage of people visiting your website are taking the action you want them to, like making a purchase or signing up?

facts.fact: The article defines Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) as a prediction of the total revenue a business can expect from a single customer over the entire time they do business with it.
